[NorduGrid Collaboration](http://www.nordugrid.org>), is an open source software
solution enabling e-Science computing infrastructures with emphasis on
processing of large data volumes.

since its first release in 2002.

name: nordugrid-arc
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: nordugrid-arc
  version: "7.1.2"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: http://download.nordugrid.org/packages/nordugrid-arc/releases/${{ version }}/src/nordugrid-arc-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 1393e721a7c67688f8298627e1b3674dd8f6d48d22aa76eb8905c9912885b30b
  patches:
    - 0004-Fix-finding-INSTPREFIX.patch
    - 0001-Replace-use-of-distutils-for-Python-3.12-compatibili.patch
    - 0006-Fix-swig-4.3-multi-phase-module-init.patch

build:
  number: 1
  skip:
    - win
    - osx
    - ppc64le
  dynamic_linking:
    # Linkage was verified clean against the run dependencies (all NEEDED libs
    # are provided by the run-exports of the host deps), so make regressions fatal.
    overlinking_behavior: error
    overdepending_behavior: error

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - pkg-config
    - make
    - autoconf
    - automake
    - gettext
    - libtool
    - help2man
  host:
    - python
    - swig
    - cppunit
    - gct
    - gfal2
    - glib
    - glibmm-2.4
    - libsigcpp
    - libuuid
    - libxml2
    - openssl
    - sqlite
    - libxrootd-devel
    - zlib
  run:
    - python

tests:
  # 1. Every swig sub-module imports. This also guards the multi-phase module
  #    initialisation glue (broken by SWIG >= 4.3 until patched).
  - python:
      imports:
        - arc
        - _arc
        - arc.common
        - arc.loader
        - arc.message
        - arc.compute
        - arc.communication
        - arc.credential
        - arc.data
        - arc.delegation
        - arc.security
      pip_check: false
  # 2. Functional tests that exercise the compiled libraries end to end.
  - script:
      # Drive real code through the swig bindings: URL parsing, ArcLocation,
      # UserConfig and Logger all call into libarccommon/libarccredential.
      - python -c "import arc, os; u = arc.URL('https://example.org:8443/d?a=b'); assert (u.Protocol(), u.Host(), u.Port(), u.Path()) == ('https', 'example.org', 8443, '/d'), u; assert os.path.isdir(arc.ArcLocation.Get()); arc.UserConfig(); arc.Logger.getRootLogger(); print('arc bindings functional')"
      # Copy a local file through the file data-management plugin: this loads
      # libarccommon + libarcdata + lib/arc/libdmcfile.so at runtime, proving the
      # data stack and its dynamic linkage actually work (not just that files exist).
      - echo "nordugrid-arc conda-forge functional test" > infile.txt
      - arccp "file://${PWD}/infile.txt" "file://${PWD}/outfile.txt"
      - cmp infile.txt outfile.txt
      # Cheap link smoke for tool families the above do not cover; each loads a
      # different set of libraries (credential/crypto, compute, infosys).
      - arcproxy --help
      - arcsub --help
      - arcinfo --help
  # 3. Strict check of the packaged payload. Directory-level globs absorb
  #    within-directory churn (new plugins, locales, headers, soname bumps) while
  #    strict fails the build on anything outside them. The python glob is scoped
  #    to site-packages so a stdlib __pycache__ leak into lib/python*/ (cleaned in
  #    build.sh) would not match and would be caught here.
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      bin:
        - arccp
        - arcproxy
        - arcsub
      lib:
        - libarccommon
        - libarccompute
        - libarcdata
      include:
        - arc/ArcVersion.h
      files:
        - bin/**
        - sbin/**
        - lib/libarc*.so*
        - lib/arc/**
        - lib/python*/site-packages/**
        - libexec/arc/**
        - include/arc/**
        - share/arc/**
        - share/man/man*/*
        - share/locale/*/LC_MESSAGES/*.mo
        - etc/arc.conf
        - etc/arc/**
        - etc/bash_completion.d/*
        - etc/rc.d/init.d/*

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Advanced Resource Connector Middleware
  description: |
    The Advanced Resource Connector (ARC) middleware, developed by the
    [NorduGrid Collaboration](http://www.nordugrid.org>), is an open source software
    solution enabling e-Science computing infrastructures with emphasis on
    processing of large data volumes.
    ARC has been used to enable national and international e-infrastructures
    since its first release in 2002.
  homepage: http://www.nordugrid.org/
  repository: https://source.coderefinery.org/nordugrid/
  documentation: http://www.nordugrid.org/arc/arc6

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - chrisburr
